_comment: Séance Cat Pose 3 — Gorey-Ink + Cyberpunk with OpenPose ControlNet. Extends gorey-ink-pose-3-probe.workflow.json by inserting LoadImage (node 10) → ControlNetLoader (node 11) → ControlNetApply (node 12) between CLIPTextEncode-positive (6) and KSampler (3). Strength 0.8. Seed 42, 30 steps, CFG 7.5, 1024². The driver render-openpose.py swaps the prompt strings on node 6/7 for the cyberpunk variant. Rig PNG is loaded by filename from ComfyUI's input dir — the driver copies it there before queueing.
